items.name: CubiKonce 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE4MjQ4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--590b037ec0d3ce4bc08e4642e57fb0a9104ecc9e/CubiKonce2027.2.png) # **CubiKonce 2027** ​ ## **Español** ​ ¡Se celebra en Concepción la onceava edición de la competición **"CubiKonce"**, en esta ocasión llamada **"CubiKonce 2027"**! ​ ✨ **¡Los esperamos con ansias en esta competición!** 🍀 **¡Buena suerte, amigos cuberos!** ​ No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de esta emocionante competición. **¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades cuberas y disfrutar de un día lleno de diversión!** ​ **¡Nos vemos en Concepción!** --- ​ ## **English** ​ The eleventh edition of the **'CubiKonce'** competition is taking place in Concepción, this time named **'CubiKonce 2027.'**! ​ ✨ **We eagerly await your participation in this competition.** 🍀 **Good luck, cube enthusiast friends!** ​ Don't miss the opportunity to be part of this thrilling competition. **Get ready to challenge your cubing skills and enjoy a day filled with fun!** ​ **See you in Concepción!**

Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [[FAQ]](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NilvangeOpen2027#62624-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. items.name: Split Cubing Day 2027
items.information: (HR) Split Cubing Day 2027 je natjecanje koje se održava u Splitu. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost. Preporučujemo da budete upoznati s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. ---- (EN) Split Cubing Day 2027 is a competition taking place in Split. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are. We recommend that you be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free.
